# Agent Review Skill

Automates review and refinement of agents, hooks, instructions, and prompts. Ensures customizations are up-to-date and effective.

## Example Prompts
- "Review agent hooks for maintenance."
- "Update agent instructions for new workflow."
- "Refine custom prompts for task automation."
